name: Cisco ASA — SSH Proxy / Tunnel-Like Activity
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter _raw_log contains "302014"
| alter src_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_ip,
        dst_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
        src_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.src_port),
        dst_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_port),
        src_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_interface,
        dst_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_interface,
        proto    = _json -> generalCiscoLog.protocol,
        bytes_n  = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.transferred_bytes)
| filter dst_port = 22
| alter proxy_host = src_host, ssh_tgt = dst_host
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count_distinct(ssh_tgt) as victims,
       values(ssh_tgt) as ssh_targets,
       sum(bytes_n) as total_bytes
       by proxy_host, _time
| filter victims >= 5 and total_bytes >= 10000000
| alter ssh_port = 22
| fields proxy_host, ssh_targets, ssh_port, victims, total_bytes
description: Single source SSH'ing to many internal targets with proxy-like byte volume.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — SSH Proxy / Tunnel-Like Activity
alert_description:
What fired: Single source SSH'ing to many internal targets with proxy-like byte volume.

Why it matters: an actor is pivoting from one host to others inside the network. Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1021.004 - SSH (TA0008 - Lateral Movement).

Investigate:
  - Map the source host, the internal targets reached, and the account used.
  - Check for preceding credential access on the source and for new logons/sessions on the targets.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (proxy_host) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
